response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT r.media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - o.average_rate AS amount_above_average FROM media_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.rate > o.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with zero Milliseconds have no defined byte rate and are excluded from the rate average.
